exports.name: fetchCallReadOnlyFunction
exports.description:
Calls a function as read-only from a contract interface.
It is not necessary that the function is defined as read-only in the contract

tags.name: param
tags.text: opts.contractName - The contract name

tags.name: param
tags.text: opts.contractAddress - The contract address

tags.name: param
tags.text: opts.functionName - The contract function name

tags.name: param
tags.text: opts.functionArgs - The contract function arguments

tags.name: param
tags.text: opts.senderAddress - The address of the (simulated) sender

tags.name: param
tags.text: opts.api - Optional API info (`.url` & `.fetch`) used for fetch call

param.name: opts.api
param.description: Optional API info (`.url` & `.fetch`) used for fetch call

tags.name: return
tags.text:
Returns an object with a status bool (okay) and a result string that
is a serialized clarity value in hex format.

tags.name: example
